program: B.Sc. in Industrial and Production Engineering (IPE)

courses.title: Modeling with Calculus and ODE
content_summary: Differential and integral calculus extended to ordinary differential equations and mathematical modeling of physical systems.

courses.title: Structure of Matter, Electricity, Magnetism and Modern Physics
content_summary: Atomic and nuclear structure, electricity and magnetism fundamentals, and an introduction to modern physics.

courses.title: Physical and Inorganic Chemistry
content_summary: Physical chemistry (thermodynamics, kinetics, electrochemistry) and inorganic chemistry relevant to engineering materials.

courses.title: Introduction to Industrial and Production Engineering
content_summary: A first look at the IPE profession: manufacturing systems, production management, and where the discipline fits between engineering and management.

courses.title: Workshop Practice I
content_summary: Hands-on practice with hand tools, fitting, carpentry, and basic bench work in the workshop.

courses.title: Engineering Drawing
content_summary: Orthographic and isometric projection, dimensioning, and technical drawing conventions used across engineering.

courses.title: Statics and Dynamics
content_summary: Forces, moments, and equilibrium of rigid bodies (statics), plus motion and forces in dynamic systems.

courses.title: Statics and Dynamics Lab
content_summary: Experiments verifying statics and dynamics principles — equilibrium, friction, and motion analysis.

courses.title: Arabic / English Language I
content_summary: Language proficiency and communication practice (Arabic/English), building academic and professional communication skills.

courses.title: Islamic Culture and Professional Ethics
content_summary: Islamic culture, ethics, and their application to professional and engineering conduct.

courses.title: PDE, Special Functions, Laplace and Fourier Analysis
content_summary: Partial differential equations, special functions, and Laplace/Fourier transform methods used throughout engineering analysis.

courses.title: Waves and Oscillation, Geometrical Optics and Wave Mechanics
content_summary: Wave motion, oscillations, geometrical optics, and an introduction to wave mechanics.

courses.title: Physics Lab
content_summary: Laboratory verification of oscillation, wave, and optics phenomena covered in theory.

courses.title: Chemistry of Engineering Materials
content_summary: Structure, properties, and behavior of engineering materials from a chemistry perspective — polymers, metals, and composites.

courses.title: Chemistry Lab
content_summary: Laboratory experiments on material composition, reactions, and properties.

courses.title: Electrical Circuits and Machines
content_summary: Fundamentals of electrical circuits (DC/AC analysis) and an introduction to electrical machines.

courses.title: Electrical Circuits and Machines Lab
content_summary: Circuit-building and machine experiments reinforcing the electrical circuits and machines theory.

courses.title: Workshop Practice II
content_summary: Machine-shop practice — turning, drilling, milling, and welding fundamentals.

courses.title: 3D Solid Modeling and Assembling
content_summary: Parametric 3D solid modeling and assembly design using CAD software.

courses.title: Material Engineering
content_summary: Structure–property relationships of engineering materials, heat treatment, and material selection.

courses.title: Material Engineering Lab
content_summary: Material testing experiments — hardness, tensile strength, and microstructure examination.

courses.title: Arabic / English Language II
content_summary: Continued language and communication practice (Arabic/English) at an intermediate level.

courses.title: Vector Analysis, Multivariable Calculus and Complex Variables
content_summary: Vector calculus, multivariable calculus, and complex variable theory used in engineering analysis.

courses.title: Electronics and Digitization Techniques
content_summary: Semiconductor devices, analog/digital electronics, and digitization techniques.

courses.title: Electronics and Digitization Techniques Lab
content_summary: Circuit-building labs covering diodes, transistors, and basic digital logic.

courses.title: Manufacturing Processes I
content_summary: Traditional manufacturing processes — casting, forming, and joining — and their engineering trade-offs.

courses.title: Manufacturing Processes I Lab
content_summary: Practical exposure to casting, forming, and joining processes on real equipment.

courses.title: Thermodynamics and Heat Transfer
content_summary: Laws of thermodynamics, thermodynamic cycles, and modes of heat transfer.

courses.title: Thermodynamics and Heat Transfer Lab
content_summary: Experiments measuring heat transfer and thermodynamic cycle performance.

courses.title: Computer Programming and Applications
content_summary: Structured programming fundamentals and their application to engineering problem-solving.

courses.title: Computer Programming and Applications Lab
content_summary: Programming assignments and mini-projects building on the programming theory course.

courses.title: Science, Technology and Islam
content_summary: The relationship between science, technology, and Islamic thought.

courses.title: Linear Algebra and Solid Geometry
content_summary: Matrices, vector spaces, linear transformations, and solid (3D) geometry.

courses.title: Manufacturing Processes II
content_summary: Machining and material-removal processes — turning, milling, grinding — and non-traditional manufacturing.

courses.title: Manufacturing Processes II Lab
content_summary: Practical machining exercises on lathes, mills, and grinding equipment.

courses.title: Mechanics of Materials
content_summary: Stress, strain, and deformation of engineering materials under load.

courses.title: Mechanics of Materials Lab
content_summary: Experimental verification of stress–strain behavior and material failure modes.

courses.title: Measurement, Instrumentation and Control
content_summary: Sensors, measurement systems, and fundamentals of feedback control.

courses.title: Measurement, Instrumentation and Control Lab
content_summary: Hands-on measurement and instrumentation experiments.

courses.title: Industrial Law and Management
content_summary: Labor and industrial law, and management principles for running an industrial organization.

courses.title: Principles of Economics and Cost Accounting
content_summary: Micro/macroeconomics fundamentals and cost accounting techniques for engineering decisions.

courses.title: Numerical Analysis
content_summary: Numerical methods for solving equations, systems, and differential equations computationally.

courses.title: Numerical Analysis Lab
content_summary: Computer-based implementation of the numerical methods covered in theory.

courses.title: Probability and Statistics
content_summary: Probability theory and statistical inference applied to engineering data and quality decisions.

courses.title: CAD/CAM/CAE
content_summary: Computer-aided design, manufacturing, and engineering — bridging design software with production.

courses.title: CAD/CAM/CAE Lab
content_summary: Hands-on CAD/CAM/CAE software practice, from modeling to toolpath generation.

courses.title: Mechanics of Machines
content_summary: Kinematics and dynamics of mechanisms — linkages, cams, and gears.

courses.title: Mechanics of Machines Lab
content_summary: Experiments analyzing motion and forces in mechanical systems.

courses.title: Fluid Mechanics and Machinery
content_summary: Fluid statics/dynamics and the machinery (pumps, turbines) built around fluid systems.

courses.title: Fluid Mechanics and Machinery Lab
content_summary: Laboratory measurement of fluid flow and machinery performance.

courses.title: Engineering Economy and Finance
content_summary: Engineering economic analysis — time value of money, project evaluation, and financing decisions.

courses.title: Business Communications and Seminar
content_summary: Professional communication skills and a seminar on presenting technical work.

courses.title: Manufacturing Planning and Control
content_summary: Production planning, scheduling, and control techniques for manufacturing systems.

courses.title: Quality Control and Management
content_summary: Statistical quality control, quality management systems, and continuous improvement.

courses.title: Control Engineering and Industrial Automation
content_summary: Control systems theory applied to industrial automation.

courses.title: Product Design I
content_summary: Product design methodology — from concept generation to detailed design (part I).

courses.title: Capstone Design I
content_summary: Guided capstone project work applying design methodology to a real problem (part I).

courses.title: Operations Research
content_summary: Optimization and decision-making models — linear programming, queuing, and related OR techniques.

courses.title: Modeling and Simulation Lab
content_summary: Building and analyzing simulation models of manufacturing/production systems.

courses.title: Elective Subject I
content_summary: Chosen from the department's approved elective/specialization list for IPE, based on availability that semester.

courses.title: Project and Thesis I
content_summary: Independent research/thesis work — problem definition and early-stage investigation (part I).

courses.title: Ergonomics and Safety Management
content_summary: Human factors, workplace design, and occupational safety management.

courses.title: Ergonomics and Safety Management Lab
content_summary: Practical ergonomic assessment and safety-management exercises.

courses.title: Product Design II
content_summary: Continuation of product design methodology into prototyping and evaluation (part II).

courses.title: Capstone Design II
content_summary: Guided capstone project work, continued — refinement and completion (part II).

courses.title: Material Handling and Maintenance Management
content_summary: Material handling systems and maintenance-management strategies for industrial equipment.

courses.title: Material Handling and Maintenance Management Lab
content_summary: Applied exercises in material handling system design and maintenance planning.

courses.title: Supply Chain Management
content_summary: Supply chain design, logistics, and coordination across a production network.

courses.title: Industrial Training
content_summary: A compulsory industry placement applying classroom knowledge in a real manufacturing/production setting.

courses.title: Project and Thesis II
content_summary: Independent research/thesis work — completion, analysis, and defense (part II).

courses.title: Project and Environmental Management
content_summary: Project management principles and environmental-impact considerations for industrial projects.

courses.title: Machine Tools
content_summary: Machine tool design and operation — the equipment behind modern manufacturing.

courses.title: Machine Tools Lab
content_summary: Hands-on machine-tool operation and measurement exercises.
